verdict.rationale: Mercury explicitly markets running operations "from your terminal, a script, or a CI pipeline." It ships a terminal-native CLI that authenticates non-interactively via a MERCURY_API_KEY environment variable, backed by a REST API with scoped tokens and a sandbox base URL for safe automated testing. missing for 10: a dedicated CI integration guide or pipeline examples (e.g., GitHub Actions), in-depth CLI reference documentation beyond the repo pointer, and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Run Mercury operations from your terminal, a script, or a CI pipeline
Automate your financial operations with a full banking API, terminal-native CLI, and AI-ready MCP server.
The CLI handles auth itself: set MERCURY_API_KEY in your environment, or run mercury login
Issue scoped API tokens with fine-grained permissions
When making API requests, make sure they're pointed to our sandbox base URL: https://api-sandbox.mercury.com/api/v1/
